role: One unchanged-mechanism post-open Case 19 full-sequence gate with a result-blind execution amendment. It extends the independently sealed v264 frame-zero half-ray correction to all 33 already opened snapshots and all 13 frozen rigs without changing the parent, depth, ray mask, coefficient, preconditioner, controls, metrics, thresholds or cost accounting.
scientific_question: Does the exact v264 even-quincunx half-ray correction retain absolute and K16-matched field, full-gradient, interior-gradient and observation accuracy on every one of 429 Case 19 cells and every complete-rig tail, while neither the cheaper v258 endpoint nor the equal-total-ray-work K15 control explains the result?
physical_hypothesis: If the observation tail corrected at frame zero is a stable solver-native local-ray defect rather than a single-frame coincidence, the identical selected-ray normal step should remain safe across the complete opened Case 19 sequence without access to truth, time, frame index or rig labels.
design_evidence_boundary: Case 19 and v264 are already open. The v264 frame-zero arrays may be used only as immutable implementation anchors. Two v265.0 executions are quarantined: the first reached all 429 predictions and metrics but failed before a nonempty formal report because NumPy booleans were not JSON-native; the second sealed an INCONCLUSIVE report because only the freshly recomputed K15 control differed from its older v261-backed v264 process anchor by more than 1e-12. Before freezing v265.1, no candidate/control accuracy value, pass count, tail, summary or gate outcome from either execution was read. Only output existence, finiteness, false validity keys, implementation-anchor differences and their per-arm attribution were inspected. No v265.1 candidate field, residual, selected-ray state, metric, tail or gate value may be computed before this amended protocol, runner, independent validator and tests are frozen in one clean source commit.

execution_amendment_v265_1.reason: v264 copied its K15 control from a separately sealed v261 process, whereas v265 correctly recreates K15 in the current process for every cell. A 1e-12 cross-process bitwise-style anchor is stricter than the already frozen 1e-6 formal-independent numerical-equivalence contract and conflicts with the recreated-control definition.
execution_amendment_v265_1.fixed_anchor_policy: The primary, recreated v258 endpoint and K16 reference retain the original 1e-12 same-implementation frame-zero field, residual and metric anchors. The freshly recreated K15 control must match its older v264 process anchor within the pre-existing 1e-6 formal-independent field, residual and metric limits. Selected-ray state remains under the original 1e-12 anchor. No new tolerance was fitted to an accuracy result.

frozen_data_and_geometry.camera_roster: Reuse the exact labeled nine-camera roster and canonical camera-ID adapter from v244/v264 for every rig and frame.
frozen_data_and_geometry.preprocessing: Reuse the exact v244 float64 rectilinear interpolation, one-voxel support and active-cell gauge for all 33 snapshots.
frozen_data_and_geometry.truth_use: CFD truth generates synthetic observations and scores four veto metrics only. It never enters the parent, selected-ray mask, direction, coefficient, controls, fallback or stopping.

unique_primary.name: v258_endpoint_plus_even_quincunx_half_ray_preconditioned_normal_line_search
unique_primary.mechanism_identity: Bit-for-bit the v264 definition: recreate zero-start geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K13; apply fixed six-neighbor linear heat with tau=1/12 for 12 steps; remove the full K13 measurement-Krylov projection; restart unchanged PCGLS K1; then apply one exact even-quincunx selected-ray adjoint, the same positive geometry-Jacobi inverse, one exact selected-ray forward and alpha=<q_S,r_S>/<q_S,q_S> without clipping, damping or fallback.
unique_primary.ray_mask: Every camera retains detector rays satisfying zero-based (u+v) mod 2 = 0 and retains both signed components. The fixed mask contains 1152/2304 rays.
unique_primary.candidate: x_candidate=x_v258+alpha*d; its full physical residual is replayed offline before truth scoring.

controls.name: recreated_v258_endpoint
controls.definition: The exact v258 endpoint recreated independently for every cell.

controls.name: zero_geometry_jacobi_pcgls_k15
controls.definition: Unmodified zero-start geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K15 recreated for every cell.

controls.name: k16_reference
controls.definition: Unmodified zero-start geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K16 used only as the frozen matched-accuracy denominator. It is not required to pass its own absolute gate.

forbidden_search: No parent, depth, heat step, complement rank, ray fraction, parity, phase, coordinate origin, camera/component subset, residual mask, alpha rule, clipping, damping, ridge, preconditioner, endpoint blend, temporal state, frame rule, rig rule, metric threshold or fallback may change. Do not inspect failed cells to try odd parity, another fraction or another depth. Do not rescue with a selector, CNN, FNO, UNO, DeepONet or GPU.

accuracy_contract.two_replica_envelope: For the primary and controls use the componentwise maximum of formal and independent metrics. For K16 use the componentwise minimum. Every candidate/control absolute and matched cell, rig p90 and rig worst gate is then evaluated on this conservative envelope.
accuracy_contract.control_dominance: If recreated v258 or equal-total-ray-work K15 passes every absolute and K16-matched cell and complete-rig tail gate, the half-ray advantage is not isolated.

independent_validation.formal_implementation: Existing frozen v258 eig-based complement and v264 Torch selected-ray gather/scatter, with the established exact NumPy full operator and formal Case 19 parser.
independent_validation.independent_implementation: A separate program must use the established independent raw-density parser, explicit exact forward/adjoint, Cholesky K13 complement, independent PCGLS, NumPy finite differences, explicit selected-ray gathers and numpy.add.at scatters. It must not import the v265 formal runner.
independent_validation.frame_zero_anchor: Formal and independent programs must each reproduce their own sealed v264 frame-zero primary, recreated-v258 and K16 fields, residuals and metrics within 1e-12; observations, inverse diagonal, selected state and audit also remain within 1e-12. Because v264 copied K15 from an older v261 process while v265 recreates it, K15 is anchored separately under the pre-existing 1e-6 formal-independent numerical-equivalence limits. Every per-arm difference must be sealed before a full-sequence decision is admissible.
independent_validation.prediction_barrier: Both programs seal all 429 fields, residuals, observations, selected-ray states and call ledgers before truth metrics are computed. The independent program seals its prediction tree before reading v265 formal scientific arrays.

decision_order: Any identity, input tree, source closure, shape, finite, parser, observation, Jacobi, v258 mechanism, selected-ray operator, adjoint, normal identity, least-squares orthogonality, physical replay, permutation, call-ledger, prediction barrier, amended frame-zero anchor or formal-independent closure failure gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_CASE19_STRATIFIED_RAY_CORRECTION_FULL_SEQUENCE_V265_1.

If the primary fails any of 429 absolute or K16-matched cells, or any complete-rig absolute/matched p90-higher or worst gate, conclude FAIL_CASE19_STRATIFIED_RAY_CORRECTION_FULL_SEQUENCE_V265_1 and close this unchanged half-ray route.
If the primary passes but recreated v258 or equal-total-ray-work K15 also passes the complete contract, conclude PASS_CASE19_FULL_SEQUENCE_BUT_STRATIFIED_RAY_ADVANTAGE_NOT_ISOLATED_V265_1.

Only if the primary passes all cell and complete-rig gates, both controls remain incomplete and the independent implementation passes may conclude POST_OPEN_CASE19_STRATIFIED_RAY_CORRECTION_FULL_SEQUENCE_HEADROOM_V265_1. This authorizes only a separately frozen fresh wall/RSS gate; it is not external generalization, a paper result or real BOST.
failure_action: Close the exact even-quincunx half-ray correction without changing parity, fraction, alpha, preconditioner, parent, depth, controls or thresholds. Do not train or rent a GPU to rescue it.
